tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ gu ru drag sgrub kyi nyams len rgyun khyer zin phris bzhugs so/ 234) na mo ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐/ mkha' mnyam 'gro ba drin can pha ma rnams// lam log skyobs phyir rigs 'dus bla ma bsgrub// myur du de yi go 'phang thob par bya// snang srid thams cad mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang*// snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang gi dbus// padma nyi zla bdud bzhi bsnol ba'i steng*// rang rig hūm̐ dmar me yi mdog can las// 'od 'phros rgyal ba mchod cing 'gro sgrib sbyang*// gdug pa can btul tshur 'dus yongs gyur las// rang nyid che mchog padma drag po rtsal// dmar nag rab khros zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche gtsigs spyan gsum bsgrad// thod skam rin chen dbu brgyan thod rlon phreng*// glang chen thod rlon stag sham sbrul chun dang*// mi lpags rin chen dar sogs du mas brgyan// phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu gdengs// g.yon pa lcags sdig rgyal 'gong snying rtsa 'jibs// me spungs klong na g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bzhugs// spyi gtsug pad steng rje btsun thod phreng rtsal// zhi 'dzum pad zhwa ber phod chos 236) gos gsol// rdo rje thod pa dang bcas yum dang 'khril// yum chen mtsho rgyal dkar mo gri gug 'dzin// gu ru'i dbu gtsug khyung nag me gshog can// kriṃ kying sgra sgrog klu gdon zhal du gsol// de'i spyi bor rigs bdag snang mtha' yas// dmar gsal lhung gzed 'dzin cing chos gos gsol// mtshan dpes brgyan cing gzi 'od 'bar bar bzhugs// bdag nyid drag po'i dpral bar 'jam dpal ser// ral gri sdig mdzub dang bcas 'khor lo 'dzin// mgrin par rta mgrin dmar po khro gtum tshul// gri gug thod khrag dud khrod chas can gsol// thugs kar gser gyi mchod rten bum pa'i nang*// gsang bdag mthing nag rdo rje dril bu 'dzin// lte bar phag mo mthing nag khro 'dzum zhal// gri gug thod khrag mchan g.yon kha ṭwaṃ 'dzin// rin chen rus brgyan mgo 'phreng la sogs brgyan// gsang bar yaksha me dbal smug

237) nag 'bar// phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas tho ba dang*// zhags pa 'dzin cing rab tu khros par bskyed// rang gi phyi rim rang mdangs 'khor gyi tshogs// he ru yab yum bzhi dang drag po bzhi// phur pa bzhi dang khro bcu la sogs pa// sprul 'khor tshogs kyang skad cig dran rdzogs su// sku mdog phyag mtshan rnam 'gyur sna tshogs pa// cir snang ma 'gags rgyan gyi rol par gsal// de ltar lha tshogs rnams kyi gnas gsum du// 'bru 'bum dag las 'od 'phros rnga yab nas// gu ru yab yum rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// spyan drangs dam tshig pa dang gnyis med bstim// rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i spyi dpal yin pa'i phyir// dbang bskur rgyas gdab spros pa kun las 'das/ phyi nang snod bcud dngos po ma lus kun// mchod pa'i dngos por ye nas lhun gyis grub// rang rig rang gsal bstod pa'i rgyal po nyid// kun rdzob tshig gis bstod las khyad par 'phags/ 238) ༈ de nas zhi bar bsnyen dang khro bor bsgrub// gnyis las dang po zhi bsnyen rim pa ni// spyi gtsug gu ru'i thugs kar hūm̐ dmar las// 'od 'phros rgyal kun byin rlabs nus mthu brdzus// gu ru nyid la thim pas 'od du zhu// bdag gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang dbyer med bsam// hūm̐ mthar sngags phreng mar me'i phreng ba ltar// bskor zhing zhi ba'i 'dzab 'di 'bru 'bum mam// bdun 'bum gsum 'bum gang 'os bzlas byas na// 'khu ldog bar chad mi 'byung man ngag yin// om̐ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru de wa ḍā kki ni hūm̐/ thun mtshams hūm̐ la thams cad bsdus nas ni// stong nyid ngang nas smon lam rgya cher gdab// rjes thob lha yi ting 'dzin spyi ltarabya// dngos gzhi khro bo bsgrub pa'i rim pa ni// gtor ma rin chen 'bar ba sman rag dang*// mchod sogs bshams zhing skyabs sems sngon btang nas// bdag dang go 239) cha'i lha tshogs gong ltar gsal la/

lha tshogs kyi rnams kyi gnas su 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyasartsa gsum lha bla ma mkha' 'gro chos skyong spyan drangs mdun gyi mkhar bzhugs pa'i thugs rje rgyud bskul 'od zer 'phros/ bdag la thim zhim bdag gis ba spu'i khungs kun nas 'od 'phros de las bsrung ba'i gur/ gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong steng nas phubs/ rtsibs kyi rtse nas lcags sdig tsha tsha 'phro/ 'og nas lcags kyi 'khor lo spu gri'i rtsibs stong ldan gyen du kha bstan rab 'khor zhing*/ de gnyis bar du me yi 'khor lo 'bar/ steng 'og 'khor lo g.yas g.yon bsnol ba'i bar/ rgyal bsen mgo lus phye mar btub nas kyang*/ me yi 'khor los gzhob tu bsreg par bsam/ slar yang bdag gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig las/ khro rgyal yaksha 240) me dbal grangs med 'phros// 'jig rten khams gang gnod byed tshogs kun bcom// bdag nyid drag po'i zhal nas sngags kyi 'od// me yi spu gri rab 'bar phar 'phros shing*/ me dbal rnams kyi zhal nas tshur yang 'phros// de gnyis bar du rgyal bsen 'byung po'i tshogs// gzhob tu sreg cing rdul du brlag par bsam// stong gsal rig pa'i ngar ldan sngags 'di bzlas// om̐ āḥhūm̐/

ar tsig nir tsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ āḥhūm̐ phaṭaḥ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ.om̐ badzra hūm̐/ yaksha hūm̐/raksha hūm̐/ rā dzrā gnod byed snying la ma ra ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ bdun 'bum bzlas pas mchog dngos 'grub par gsungs/ dā dzā snying po'i rgyal po yin/ rā dzā thung ngu nyul la 'jug thun mtshams gtor mchod bskang gso'i las la 'bad/ skabs su go cha'i lha 241) rnams so so yi// thugs kar rang rang srog rnying sngags phreng kyang*/ so sor 'khor dmigs nus pa lhag par che// snang mtha'i thugs kar āḥdamar mtha' skor du// om̐ a mṛ de wā ā yu siddhi hūm̐/ khyung chen thugs kar khrom gyi mtha' skor du// om̐ badzra khroṃ ga ru ṭa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭaḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i thugs kar om̐ ser mthar// om̐ badzra shrī ya manta ka hūm̐ phaṭaḥ rta mgrin thugs kar hrīḥdamar mtha' skor du// om̐ padma ta krid ma hā kro dha hya gṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ phyag rdor thugs kar hūm̐ mthing mtha' ma ru// om̐ badzra pā ṇi nī laṃ dhā ra ma hā kro dha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ lte ba'i phag mo'i thugs kar bam yig mthar// om̐ buddha ḍākki ni hrīḥm hā ri ni sa hūm̐ dzaḥ me dbal thugs ka'i hūm̐ nag mtha' skor du/ om̐ badzra 242) hūm̐/ yaksha hūm̐/raksha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ sngags rnams so so'i sku mdog dag mtshungs bsgom/ bsnyen grangs them nas drag sngags spyi dril 'di lnga stong bzlas na gnas lcags thogs kyang bzlog om̐ badzra ma hā kro dha ma hā kro dhi shwa ri badzra kī li kī la ya ma hā aksha kā ma rū pa karma ram ram dzwa la raṃ hūm̐/ gnod byed 'byung po hur thum ma ra ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ 'di ltar rgyal ba kun 'dus gu ru yi// thugs srog snying po gcig tu dril ba 'di// ji tsam bzlas pa de mtshungs nus par ldan// thun mtshams thams cad thugs ka'i hūm̐ la bdud// hūm̐ nyid nam mkha'i dbyings su 'ja' yal bzhin// mi dmigs stong pa'i klong du bzhag nas kyang*/

de yi dge bas 'gro ba yongs la bsngo*/ slar yang lha yi nga rgyal dang ldan pas// spyod lam chos dang mthun pa dus 'da' bya// 243) ༈ de ltar snyigs dus ma rungs 'dre srin tshogs// chos byed kun la 'tshe de'i gnyen po mchog /dkyil 'khor kun gtso he ru ka dpal che// 'di grub rgyal ba kun dang mthu rtsal mnyam// skyed rdzogs nyams len bsnyen sgrub mtha' dag la// don dam ye shes spros bral gnad rig cing*// kun rdzob rtsal snang 'gro la snying rje bsgom// sngags dang ting 'dzin drag las sbyor ba kun// zhi bas mi thul rgyal 'gong dam sri la// gang 'dul rol pa'i snying rjes khro tshul las// gdug cing sdang ba'i sems kyis bya ba yin// drag po'i nad la sman dpyad drag bsten bzhin// gzhan phan lam la 'god phyir kho nas 'bad// 'di ltar ma nor brtson pas nyams blangs na// rdzogs sangs rgyas la bka' ba'i tshogs ma mchis// 'di bris dge bas mkha' mnyam 'gro kun kyang*// rigs 'dus bla ma'i go 'phang myur thob shog ༈ gter ston padma rig 'dzin rtsal gyis gdan drangs pa'i zab chos bla ma nor bu pad 'phreng gi drag sgrub kyi nyams len rgyun khyer snying por dril ba 'di yang rnal 'byor tshul khrims bzang po'i don du bkod pa dge legs 'phel/
